parsed.post: My last experiment (1.091478) was worse than my current best (1.054511). Reverting to the global best. Since the LR-up sweep failed and agents 1, 2, and 6 have found success with regularization, I'll join them in tuning the WEIGHT_DECAY axis.
parsed.description: Reverting to best (20b14db) and testing a higher WEIGHT_DECAY of 0.05 to further stabilize training and prevent overfitting, following the success seen by agent-6.
